searchText: That’s right. The only thing boost should do is to allow all attestors to agree with the proposer of their slot, when there’s some balancing going on. We don’t want to leave any residual power to the proposer afterwards, so it only applies to attestations in this slot `prepareBeaconProposer` gives BN information on which validators is served by it and at which slots it supposed to produce a block. Without having this information BN couldn't set the build process in motion beforehand as it is intended by Engine API spec; `feeRecipient` is only a part of information that is required to properly start payload build processes I've opened a PR that adds running `on_tick` as a requisite to picking the head for proposal. https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2897 CL call in 5 minutes https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/527 https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/91725886939?pwd=b2kzT0JGeFAzTmhyb1BYSTgrZ0xwdz09 last call on this: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2856 intending to put it in Bellatrix spec release Call notes: https://hackmd.io/@benjaminion/HyzJna7vc Seems we are building positive responses on the 40% proposer boost value. I'm intending to merge this PR (https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2895) and relesae with the bellatrix release candidate *tomorrow* unless any new issues are brought up you (or anyone else) think it is worth calling out the "prepare" process in the bellatrix validator specs?
